defect: Production cleanup task 14938 failed with SQLite database is locked while deleting a thumbnail; the next task succeeded.
change: Retry the same deletion candidate at most three times for SQLite BUSY/LOCKED only, rolling back and rechecking pending transfers, generation and source references on every attempt. Other errors propagate.

coverage: Real competing SQLite writer after thumbnail file unlink
Successful retry removes both asset records and files
New pending upload between attempts protects the image
Persistent contention stops after three attempts and leaves session usable
Non-lock SQLite and non-SQLite failures are not retried

limits: No claim that unrelated filesystem/database errors are recoverable
Existing SQLite busy_timeout applies to each attempt
No production collision or deletion is forced for acceptance
